about: Dark Gifts of season 36 (T-528, D-107): the 47 gift spells' names in English and Spanish from HearthstoneJSON's card data, and a short summary of each written for this project (not the card text). Used by the website's game viewer and, through tools/gift_words.py, the desktop app (crates/desktop/ui/strings/gifts.js).
